about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.title: Trusted Barcode Label Manufacturing Excellence
about.description: Astrix Glow specializes in designing and manufacturing premium barcode labeling solutions for businesses across retail, logistics, healthcare, manufacturing, and e-commerce sectors. Our commitment to quality, precision, and innovation ensures every label delivers exceptional print clarity, reliable scan performance, and long-term durability. From custom label design to large-scale production, we help brands streamline operations and improve product traceability.

features.title: Industry Expertise
features.text: Serving retail, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare, and e-commerce businesses with specialized barcode labeling solutions tailored to industry requirements.

features.title: Custom Manufacturing
features.text: Flexible production capabilities supporting custom sizes, materials, adhesives, finishes, QR codes, and variable data printing requirements.

features.title: Quality Assurance
features.text: Every label undergoes rigorous quality checks to ensure superior print clarity, durability, adhesion performance, and barcode readability.

features.title: Fast Production & Support
features.text: Efficient manufacturing workflows and dedicated customer support ensure quick turnaround times and reliable delivery schedules.
